name: Joint Light Tactical Vehicle
armament: M2, M240 or Mk 19 on ring mount or CROWS-J RWS
protection: Modular A-kit/B-kit armour, V-shaped underbody, TAK-4i independent suspension. Game rule: armoured cab immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R and larger can penetrate or disable; open gun ring leaves gunner exposed.
visual_notes: Tall, wedge-nosed 4x4 with steeply raked windscreen
Large tyres with central inflation, high ground clearance
Two-door (utility) or four-door body; heavy guns carrier with roof turret/RWS
Small armoured windows, bulky door hinges
